Note INCLUDED: the INNER-JOIN form is UNAFFECTED — the trap is SPECIFICALLY the LEFT-JOIN-for-zero-rows + `COUNT(*)` pairing; the canonical INNER JOIN query at the top of the H3 uses `COUNT(*)` safely because INNER drops zero-match buckets entirely.
